description:
Saga/process-manager glue between OpenDCB/Axon and Conductor OSS
        (github.com/conductor-oss/conductor), not a hand-built saga engine. Owns
        exactly one lookup table (saga_correlation) mapping a domain correlation
        key to a running Conductor workflow instance ID -- the one piece of
        automatic association-property indexing Axon's own saga support provided
        for free that Conductor's complete_task-by-workflow-id API does not.
